LESSON: GOVERNANCE IN ISLAM SHURA, ACCOUNTABILITY JUSTICE PARTICIPATION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat
Topic 6.2: Governance in Islam shura, accountability justice participation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Governance in Islam shura, accountability justice participation, part of Muamalat in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How can you identify a good leader? 2. Why is good leadership important in the society?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss distinctive features of governance in Islam shura, accountability, justice and participation) and present in class,

2. search online or on available reference materials for the qualities of a leader and make notes,

3. search online or on available reference materials for the significance of leadership in Islam and make class presentation,

4. dramatise the qualities of a good leader seeking Muslim Society/ Students Council leader’s position in school by applying the principles of good governance, learners with blindness can be given physical 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss distinctive features of governance in Islam shura, accountability, justice and participation) and present in class,
2. search online or on available reference materials for the qualities of a leader and make notes,
3. search online or on available reference materials for the significance of leadership in Islam and make class presentation,
4. dramatise the qualities of a good leader seeking Muslim Society/ Students Council leader’s position in school by applying the principles of good governance, learners with blindness can be given physical 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Governance in Islam shura, accountability justice participation together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
